tariff.title: בקשת הצטרפות לקופת גמל להשקעה
tariff.notes: Mor's joining request for מור גמל להשקעה, 3 pages, no printed date (file modified 2026-05-20); fees on p.2. Found through the forms search of moreinvest.co.il (פעולות נפוצות, טפסים שימושיים). Also read: joining kit form 156, same fees on p.3. Read 2026-11-06. The product page's calculator assumes 0.8% of the balance (an illustration, not used).

source.title: בקשת הצטרפות לקופת גמל להשקעה, דמי ניהול בקופת גמל

rate.notes: Printed, filled in by the company, on Mor's joining request for מור גמל להשקעה, with an asterisk: "*בכפוף לקבוע במכתב תנאי הנחה בדמי ניהול שיישלח בסמוך להצטרפות" (subject to a letter of discount terms sent after joining). So the rate is a discount from the bylaws' maximum, whose length and end conditions are in a letter not published; CMA circular 2017-9-15 has a discount last at least five years (KGL-16). The same figures are printed in Mor's joining kit (form 156, https://www.moreinvest.co.il/media/ctkmwcmo/156-%D7%A2%D7%A8%D7%9B%D7%AA-%D7%94%D7%A6%D7%98%D7%A8%D7%A4%D7%95%D7%AA-%D7%9C%D7%A7%D7%95%D7%A4%D7%AA-%D7%92%D7%9E%D7%9C-%D7%9C%D7%94%D7%A9%D7%A7%D7%A2%D7%94.pdf, p.3). On top of the fees the company may charge direct expenses for transactions (no rate printed, not recorded). A member's own agreement sets the fee actually paid (D4).
